findings.title: CI role allows Action:* on Resource:*
findings.evidence: PR #48 replaces the policy with 6 scoped statements; prowler rescan 2026-07-09 no longer reports check iam_policy_allows_full_administrative_privileges

findings.title: IAM user with 400-day-old static access keys
findings.evidence: keys deleted; the user now assumes a role via OIDC from CI; `aws iam list-access-keys` returns none

findings.title: Security group exposes Postgres 5432 to 0.0.0.0/0
findings.evidence: ingress rewritten to the app subnet CIDR; `describe-security-groups` output committed in docs/after/sg.json

findings.title: SSH 22 open to 0.0.0.0/0 on the bastion
findings.evidence: bastion removed in favour of SSM Session Manager; port 22 no longer present in any group

findings.title: Database password in EC2 user-data
findings.evidence: moved to Secrets Manager with rotation; credential rotated; gitleaks + `describe-instance-attribute --attribute userData` both clean

findings.title: No account-wide CloudTrail trail
findings.evidence: multi-region org trail 0a1b2c3d enabled with log-file validation; `describe-trails` output committed

findings.title: Two buckets without default encryption
findings.evidence: SSE-KMS applied to both; rescan reports 0 findings for check s3_bucket_default_encryption

findings.title: GuardDuty not enabled
findings.reason: Lab account with no production data; the monthly cost exceeds the value of detection here. Revisit if the account ever holds real data.

findings.title: GuardDuty not enabled
findings.reason: See baseline: cost exceeds value in a lab account with no production data.

iamLeastPrivilege.evidence: policy diffs in PR #48 and #51; access-analyzer reports no external access; last-accessed data used to drop 3 unused services

networkClosed.evidence: docs/after/sg.json — only 443 reaches the load balancer from the internet; database and app groups take traffic from their own CIDRs

secretsManaged.evidence: all four secrets in Secrets Manager with 30-day rotation; gitleaks over full history is clean; the old credential is revoked and fails to connect
